title: Busy Protocol 27 ledger as a receipt count: 216 transactions, 593 events (249 fee, 227 transfer, 117 mint)
why: A reader that ingests this ledger must end up with exactly 216 transactions, 573 operations and 593 events: 216 fee charges before all transactions plus 33 refunds after them, 227 transfers and 117 mints. The entry pins the whole-ledger counts rather than one transaction, so readers that drop failed transactions' fee events, skip refunds, double-count events or lose classic events show up as a count mismatch.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger at Protocol 27, written live by stellar-core 27.0.0.

known_divergences.detail: A MEMO_TEXT with non-ASCII bytes is written as \xNN escapes (four characters per byte), longer than the schema's maxLength 28 for string<28>; the JSON still reads back to the same bytes.
A MEMO_TEXT with non-ASCII bytes is written as \xNN escapes (four characters per byte), longer than the schema's maxLength 28 for string<28>; the JSON still reads back to the same bytes.

notes: Counted from the bytes: 249 transaction-level fee events (216 with stage before_all_txs, one per transaction, and 33 refunds with stage after_all_txs, one per Soroban transaction), 227 transfer and 117 mint operation events; there are no other events. 56 of the 216 transactions failed. 183 transactions are in the classic phase (one component, base fee 100) and 33 in the Soroban phase. No focus transaction: the expectation is the whole-ledger receipts. Written live by stellar-core 27.0.0.
